nom: Clean Your Dirty Face Savasana Stress Fix

avis.titre: CAN CAUSE BLISTERS/BURNS ON FACE IN SUNLIGHT
avis.texte: This product contains lemon peel oil which when applied to the face and used out in sunlight can make the skin super sensitive to UV rays and in turn can cause severe burns and blisters on the face. This reaction between citrus oils and UV rays is called phytophotodermatitis. It is worth noting that the lemon peel oil is likely diluted since there are several other ingredients in this toner, but it is still pretty risky to use. You would be better off buying a hypochlorous acid toner which cleans the skin and can be used post workout, but is much more gentle on the skin.
